title: Continental flags rise in German truck tire defects | European Rubber Journal
summary: Continental flags rise in German truck tire defects European Rubber Journal Featured Articles Rubber & tire machinery makers record solid growth performance 17 June 2025 Tire & rubber machinery sector bounces back 09 June 2024 Hanover, Germany – Reported tire defects on German commercial vehicles have increased by more than a quarter over five years, according to a new Continental white paper based on data from the German motor vehicle inspection association DEKRA. The number of tire defects recorded on commercial vehicles weighing more than 3.5 tonnes increased from 12,138 in 2020 to 15,436 in 2025, Continental reported 28 Sept. This represents an increase of 27% over the five-year period, while the number of tires found to be worn on one side increased by 57%. Continental did not provide a reason for the increase but noted that the number of vehicles inspected also increased, from about 343,000 in 2020 to nearly 374,000 in 2025.
